data_refresh_provenance_boundary_repair_.finding: scripts/refresh_free_data.py wrote data_refresh_provenance.json from other derived fields rather than from the panels it describes. (1) coinmetrics.date_first/date_last copied the manifest's per-metric CapMrktEstUSD time_first/time_last. Those are correct in the manifest (computed after sorting rows by time ascending) but came from different assets: date_first from the alphabetically-first asset's CapMrktEstUSD time_first -- which is that asset's LATEST observation, since the CoinMetrics timeseries endpoint paginates descending -- and date_last from the max CapMrktEstUSD time_last across assets, i.e. some other asset's EARLIEST observation.
